items.headline: Special Marine Warning issued November 13 at 1:19AM PST until November 13 at 3:15AM PST by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
SMWLOX

The National Weather Service in Los Angeles/Oxnard has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Inner waters from Point Mugu to San Mateo Pt. CA including Santa
Catalina and Anacapa Islands...
Outer waters from Santa Cruz Island to San Clemente Island to 60 NM
offshore including San Nicolas and Santa Barbara Islands...

* Until 315 AM PST.

* At 119 AM PST, a area of thunderstorms capable of producing
waterspouts was over the Inner Waters from Point Mugu to Catalina
Island. The thunderstorms were moving north around 10 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts to 34 knots.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
Two Harbors, Santa Barbara Island, Catalina Island, Rancho Palos
Verdes, King Harbor, Redondo Beach Pier, Point Dume, Redondo Beach,
Manhattan Beach, Avalon, Malibu, Los Angeles Harbor, North San
Clemente Island and Point Mugu.
items.instruction: Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

items.headline: Marine Weather Statement issued November 12 at 7:37PM PST by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
A frontal system will bring the potential for thunderstorms to
the inner waters south of Point Conception. Any thunderstorm that
forms will be capable of producing locally gusty winds up to
gale force, rough seas, dangerous lightning, heavy rainfall with
reduced visibility, and a very low chance for a waterspout.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 12 at 6:24PM PST until November 14 at 9:00AM PST by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Hazardous sea conditions.

* WHERE...Inner waters from Point Mugu to San Mateo Pt. CA
including Santa Catalina and Anacapa Islands.

* WHEN...From 6 PM Friday to 9 AM PST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...See the Coastal Waters Forecast (CWFLOX)
for more.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
